systems.name: Learning
systems.description: This system manages apprenticeship and short course learning data, including episodes, training details, learner information, and payment adjustments. It also processes events and commands related to apprenticeship and learner lifecycle updates.

systems.name: Courses
systems.description: This system manages information related to courses, including apprenticeships, frameworks, standards, routes, and sector subject areas. It supports data import, export, and interaction with external APIs and caching mechanisms.

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: The system facilitates content retrieval, management, and calculations related to campaigns, using features such as article queries, hub navigation, and funding tools. It interfaces with external systems like Redis, Azure Key Vault, and APIs for caching, key management, and outbound API communication.

systems.name: Campaign
systems.description: The system appears to manage email campaigns and user interactions related to them, including bounced emails, clicked links, displayed emails, and unsubscribed contacts. It also includes user data management features to track employer size, industry, and location.

systems.name: Funding Apprenticeship Earnings
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship earnings, including profiles, episodes, instalments, and short courses. It processes and updates earnings data and interacts with external services for messaging and payment integration.

systems.name: Payments DataLocks
systems.description: This system facilitates the management of data lock events related to apprenticeship payments, including processing apprenticeship updates and data lock events, and handling actor resets and cache resets. It also features service components for event handling and approvals processing within a Service Fabric framework.

systems.name: Commitments
systems.description: The system manages apprenticeship commitments, including creating and updating apprenticeship agreements and cohorts between employers and providers. It handles data validation, tracking changes, and integration with external services like levy matching and reservations.
capabilities: Track data locks and overlapping training dates
Integrate with external APIs for levy transfer and reservations

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: The system manages reservations for apprenticeship funding, allowing entities to create, modify, delete, and validate reservations. It integrates with external providers and utilizes databases and messaging services for communication.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: The system manages employer accounts, including their associated PAYE schemes, legal entities, agreements, users, and notifications. It provides functionality for handling apprenticeship levy data, agreements signing, invitations, and user roles.

systems.name: Reservations
systems.description: The system facilitates the management of reservations related to apprenticeships, including caching and querying funding rules, reservations, and available dates. It integrates with external APIs like Commitments and has its own Reservations API.

systems.name: Das Apim Endpoints
systems.description: This system appears to provide API endpoints and command handling functionality for managing applications, reviewers, notifications, calendar events, and organisations. It integrates with external APIs and services such as Redis caching, Azure Key Vault, and Azure services for data storage and authentication.

systems.name: Apprentice Progress
systems.description: The system tracks apprentices' progress, including knowledge, skills, and behavior, and manages associated tasks and notifications. It interacts with a SQL Server database and supports integration with an internal API for progress management.
capabilities: Knowledge, skills, and behavior progress management

systems.name: Find Apprenticeship
systems.description: This system manages saved searches and facilitates querying apprenticeship vacancies. It interacts with a SQL Server database to store and retrieve data.

systems.name: Provider Commitments
systems.description: The system facilitates cohort management functionalities, including creating cohorts and handling bulk uploads. It integrates with external APIs for approvals, permissions, PAS accounts, and commitments, and uses Redis for data caching and Azure Blob Storage for file storage.

systems.name: Employer Commitments
systems.description: The Employer Commitments system appears to manage apprenticeships and their related processes for employers. It interacts with several external APIs and uses a Redis cache for data storage.

systems.name: Provider Apprenticeships Service
systems.description: The system supports providers participating in apprenticeship programs by managing user notifications, user information, and provider details. It interacts with Azure SQL databases and external APIs for data storage and retrieval.
capabilities: Publish and consume messages through NServiceBus

systems.name: Find An Apprenticeship
systems.description: The system facilitates apprenticeship-related functionalities, such as managing applications, candidate profiles, and searching for apprenticeships. It integrates with external services like Redis for caching, Azure Key Vault for secret management, and external APIs for communication.
capabilities: Integration with external APIs and services

systems.name: Digital Certification
systems.description: The system facilitates the management, sharing, and access of digital certificates and user data. It supports actions related to certificate access, user actions, user authorizations, matches, and identity updates.
capabilities: User authorization and identity update handling

systems.name: Digital Certification Web
systems.description: This system facilitates the management and sharing of digital certificates related to courses and certifications. It includes functionalities to authorize users, create and manage certificates, handle sharing and access control, and interact with external APIs and services.

systems.name: Employer Finance
systems.description: This system manages financial transactions, levy payments, employer accounts, and transfers for organizations. It integrates with external APIs and services, such as HMRC Apprenticeship Levy, Commitments V2, Azure Service Bus, and Redis caching.
capabilities: Publish and handle service bus messages

systems.name: Provider Payments
systems.description: The system processes payment-related commands and events for providers, including handling month-end, submission statuses, and funding-related events. It interacts with SQL Server databases for data persistence and financial tracking.

systems.name: Payments V2 Common
systems.description: The system supports functionalities related to apprenticeship payments, including managing events and commands for earnings, periods, and contract types. It interacts with a SQL Server database for data storage and retrieval.

systems.name: Apprentice Commitments
systems.description: Manages apprenticeship registrations, commitments, and confirmations related to apprenticeships. It interacts with databases and message brokers to store and process relevant data.

systems.name: Apprentice Commitments Web
systems.description: This system appears to be a web application related to apprentice commitments, utilizing Redis for caching and Azure Table Storage for cloud data storage. It includes some predefined enum types for delivery models, change notifications, and roles and responsibilities confirmations.

systems.name: Apprentice Accounts Web
systems.description: This system appears to manage apprentice preferences and account-related data. It provides a web interface and interacts with a Redis cache for storing data.

systems.name: Apprentice Portal
systems.description: This system provides a web application and interacts with internal caching and cloud storage services.
capabilities: Configuration management via Azure Table Storage

systems.name: Admin Roatp
systems.description: The system appears to manage and update information related to registered apprenticeship providers, courses, and restrictions. It interacts with external APIs and uses caching for data storage optimization.
